findings.message: Container 'frontend-check' of Deployment 'loadgenerator' should specify an image tag
findings.resolution: Use a specific container image tag that is not 'latest'.

raw.Title: Image tag ":latest" used
raw.Description: It is best to avoid using the ':latest' image tag when deploying containers in production. Doing so makes it hard to track which version of the image is running, and hard to roll back the version.
raw.Message: Container 'frontend-check' of Deployment 'loadgenerator' should specify an image tag

raw.Title: Image tag ":latest" used
raw.Description: It is best to avoid using the ':latest' image tag when deploying containers in production. Doing so makes it hard to track which version of the image is running, and hard to roll back the version.
